story.iWant: my free-agent conversations to persist across browser refreshes and be listed in a thread picker so I can resume prior sessions
story.soThat: the agent feels like a continuous collaborator across days/weeks, not a fresh ephemeral chat every time I open the widget

story-context.constraints: - One table per concern: futurator-free-agent-conversations is dedicated. [Source: memory feedback_dynamodb_multi_table] - v1 scope: USER messages persisted from API layer; assistant messages stream from agent-events (deferred to v1.1). [Source: memory feedback_ship_mvp_add_later; AC #3 framing] - messageIndex derivation: Query-count+1, zero-padded to 6 digits. Race-free per session because of Story 18.2's processing lock (only one POST /messages in flight per session). v1.1 daemon-side writes will need atomic counter. - listSessionsByOperator / listSessionsByScope delegate to the existing sessions repo; do NOT duplicate the GSI queries. - All zod validation via .safeParse(); never .parse() at the route boundary. [Source: CLAUDE.md] - Auth via authMiddleware on every new route; owner check via session.operatorId. [Source: existing party + Story 18.3/18.5 routes] - npm run ci must pass with no new regressions beyond pre-existing baseline. [Source: Story 18.5 CI summary]
